Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 1st-level spells

Benefit: While you have a non-elemental spell of 1st level or higher in your known spells and have at least 1 MP in your MP pool, you can form a magic gun in a free hand as a move action, dealing 1d3 points of non-elemental damage per level of the highest-level non-elemental spell you can cast as a ranged touch attack with a max range of 120 ft. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting non-elemental spells.
